name: Swampman Backyard Ultra
description: Swampman Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon race where participants must consecutively run a distance of 6,706 meters (4.167 miles) in less than one hour. After each lap, the remaining time can be used for rest and food. Every hour, you will stand at the starting line and run another lap until only one runner remains. The Lithuanian record is 22 laps, and the world record is 108 laps.

description: Running race "Grazikai - Kelmė" in memory of V. Rimkus took place on October 28, 2023, in Kelmė, commemorating the 50th anniversary of this traditional event. This year, more than 200 runners from all over Lithuania and guests from Ukraine participated, with Vitalij Kuznetsov being the fastest over the 8 km distance. Among women, the fastest was Aurika Balsytė, originally from Kelmė district. There was also a 1.8 km race, where Lukas Mikavičius performed the best, and a 200 m race for children.

description: On October 19th at 10:00 AM, for the 10th time at Vingis Park in Vilnius, a memorial/support run "In Memoriam" will take place to honor those who sacrificed their lives for our freedom. The event brings together the community to remember and honor these heroes, and participants in the 10 km distance will compete for awards in the open Lithuanian Army Championship. There will also be opportunities to run, walk, or roll 1 km and 4 km non-competitively, where winners and prize recipients will not be selected.

name: Backyard Ultra Pasaulio čempionatas
description: The Backyard Ultra World Championship is a unique off-road running event where runners must complete a 6.7 km loop every hour until only the last one remains. The competition takes place on mountainous and off-road trails that require endurance and willpower. The event is a challenge for both physical and psychological endurance, and there is always only one winner. Trail Kalvė organizes this event with special attention to trail quality and participant experience, inviting runners to test themselves and surpass their limits.
course_highlights: Off-road trails with mountainous terrain
A 6.7 km loop every hour
The race continues until only the last runner remains
additional: The race takes place during the cold season, usually on Sundays. Participants receive a Trail Kalvė running band upon first registration of the season. Medals are awarded only for special achievements, not at every stage. About 15 athletes participate in the event, with trail distances ranging from 5 km to 60 km, free training sessions, medals and souvenirs are given, aiming to break 100 miles in 24 hours records. The event has been organized since 2022.

description: The 'In Memoriam' Run of Gratitude and Support in Vilnius is a prominent event dedicated to honoring Lithuanian Armed Forces soldiers who passed away this year and supporting their families. The event takes place in Vingis Park and includes 1 km and 4 km distances without competition, as well as a 10 km open Lithuanian Armed Forces running championship. The run originated as a heartfelt initiative to remember a young officer and has become an important annual civic and patriotic tradition. Organized by the Birutė Officers' Families Women's Union in cooperation with the Ministry of National Defence and the Lithuanian Armed Forces.
course_highlights: Vingis Park routes in Vilnius
1 km and 4 km distances without competition
10 km open Lithuanian Armed Forces running championship
additional: The event patron is the Commander of the Lithuanian Armed Forces, Gen. Raimundas Vaikšnoras. Participants can choose to run, walk, or roll the 1 km and 4 km distances without competition; winners and prize recipients are not awarded in these categories. The event also includes a 10 km run with competitive elements. Support for the families of fallen soldiers is collected via Paysera, bank account, and PayPal platform. The event is dedicated to the memory of soldiers, with proceeds allocated to their families; it takes place in the fall.

name: Trail Kursiu Nerija #TKN
description: Trail Kuršių Nerija #TKN is a wonderful run through the natural trails of the Curonian Spit in Lithuania, offering various distance options from a 1 km kids' route to an extreme 104 km. The event captivates participants with its breathtaking views, sandy paths, and the opportunity to run or walk at your own pace. It is a great chance to experience the beauty of nature and spend active time with family or friends. The event is friendly for all running levels and age groups.
course_highlights: Natural trails with plenty of sand
Various distances from 1 km for children to 104 km for extreme runners
Unmatched views of the Curonian Spit
additional: The 10 km route has a 76 m elevation gain, with a maximum of 400 participants. The 1 km kids' route is limited to 200 participants and includes running with an animator in a heated tent. Participants in the 10 km route must carry an ID and a charged mobile phone or a watch with the route's GPX. After the finish, participants can enjoy showers, massage, porridge, tea, as well as a national park ticket and outdoor games for children. The event center features a heated tent and a luggage storage area. The TKN AFTER PARTY runs until 01:30, with the last ferry to Klaipėda at 02:20. The event offers various distances, including kids' races and ultramarathons, with aid stations, GPX tracking, medals, and post-race activities. Registration closes in mid-September.

The event attracts runners of all ages, with several distances to choose from, including an 8 km main race. Participants are awarded cups, medals, and commemorative prizes.

name: VC TRAIL 2026-11-21 FINALINIS ETAPAS
description: Vilnius Challenge is a unique multisport event held since 2009, offering participants the opportunity to test their physical and psychological limits across various courses. The event includes running, cycling, orienteering, and special physical challenges, allowing for adventure experiences in the city of Vilnius and natural surroundings. Participants can choose the course level according to their preparedness - from amateurs to extreme courses with various obstacles. Vilnius Challenge promotes a healthy lifestyle, team relationships, and community spirit, bringing together sports enthusiasts and active lifestyle lovers.

The run is distinguished not only by a festive atmosphere but also by unique participants dressed in Christmas costumes. This year, the event schedule has been adjusted so that participants can run after sunset, when the Christmas spirit will shine brightly on Vilnius streets!

name: Kalėdinis bėgimas
description: Christmas Run is the most beautiful winter run in the evening, welcoming Christmas and spending time with the most memorable emotions and enchanting running energy! This year, we will run on December 7 in Vilnius, where participants can enjoy the festive atmosphere and run after dark, when the streets of the city reveal their true sparkling Christmas spirit. We invite you to prepare not only Christmas costumes but also luminous accents that will turn our group of runners into a real Christmas shining magic!

name: Kauno „Kalėdinis bėgimas - 2026“
description: Kaunas Christmas Run is a traditional running event held in Kaunas in December. The event is designed for runners of all age groups to promote a healthy lifestyle and the popularity of running. The race takes place in Panemunė Forest, with routes paved and suitable for both amateurs and professionals. After the run, participants are served kūčiukai (traditional Lithuanian Christmas cookies) and tea, and there is also an opportunity to use the swimming pool services.
course_highlights: Route in Panemunė Forest, Kaunas
Paved surface, possible snow and ice depending on weather conditions
Options to run 1.7 km, 5 km (one lap), or 10 km (two laps)
additional: Number distribution for participants on race day from 10:00 to 11:40 AM. The start fee is paid to the Kaunas Running Enthusiasts Club account. After the run, participants are served kūčiukai and tea. From 14:30 to 15:30, there is an option to swim in Žalgiris Pool (Karaliaus Mindaugo pr. 50, Kaunas). Registration is only possible in the participant's name; transfer of numbers is prohibited. Registration is open until October 31, with personalized numbers for participants. The event date is 2026-12-19.

name: Panevėžio Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: The annual Eurovaistinės Christmas Run will take place on the first winter Saturday, celebrating its 50th anniversary this year. This running event will invite thousands of participants, distinguished by a festive atmosphere and unique attendees dressed in Christmas costumes. The event schedule has been adjusted so that participants can run at dusk, when the streets of Panevėžys will reveal a magical Christmas spirit. This year, we invite not only to prepare Christmas costumes but also luminous accents that will turn the runners into a glowing Christmas magic.
course_highlights: Celebrates 50 years
Takes place on the first winter Saturday
Participants dressed in Christmas costumes
Run at dusk through Panevėžys streets
Includes luminous accents for a glowing effect

name: Bėgimas į Naujus
description: Running into the New Year is an annual race held on the last day of the year. This event brings together runners and enthusiasts who want to celebrate the arrival of the new year actively. Participants can choose from different distances, allowing everyone to find a suitable challenge. The race route offers beautiful city sights and a unique atmosphere created by participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Participants can choose from different distances
Race route features beautiful city sights
Unique atmosphere created by participants and spectators

name: Pažadų Bėgimas
description: The PROMISE RUN continues the tradition started in 2018. On January 1, 2026, in the morning, while the fireworks sounds still echo in your ears, you will confirm to yourself during the run that New Year's resolutions will definitely come true. No competition, registrations, medals, or prizes – only you and your New Year's "PROMISES". Run 10 km and write down your goals so that on January 1, 2027, you can check if they have come true. The start will take place on January 1, 2026, at 14:00 at the Kaunas Santaka Stadium.

name: Naujametinis ruonių maratonas
description: 2026-01-01 Pasvaliečiai kviečia visus klubo narius ir draugus į 1-ąjį Naujametinį RUONIŲ MARATONĄ, kuris vyks Pasvalyje. Šis maratonas yra dalis tradicinių jau 18-tų Pasvalio rajone organizuojamų ledinių maudynių. Po maratono vyks klubo narių susirinkimas, kurio metu bus apdovanoti aktyviausi klubo nariai.

name: XIV Jonavos Naujametinis bėgimas
location: Žemaitės ir P. Vaičiūno gatvių sankryža, Jonava, Lithuania
description: The 14th traditional Jonava New Year's Run will take place in 2027 on January 1st. The start will be at the intersection of Žemaitės and P. Vaičiūno streets. The traditional 20 km running route stretches through Čičinai and Kurmagala villages, with the finish line on Kauno street near the treatment facilities. The event features a hilly course and winter conditions, and after the run, participants are invited to enjoy tea, snacks, and receive commemorative medals.
course_highlights: 20 km traditional running route
Start at the intersection of Žemaitės and P. Vaičiūno streets
Route passes through Čičinai and Kurmagala villages, finish on Kauno street
additional: After the run, participants are awarded cups and prizes, receive commemorative medals, and can enjoy tea and snacks. The route is hilly, and in winter it can be slippery and windy. The course passes through Čičinai and Kurmagala villages, the weather is often wintry, and the event is popular among local runners for the New Year.

name: Resolution Run
description: Resolution Run 2026 is a fast and flat 5K run taking place on New Year's Day, January 1, 2026, at 10:15 AM in Galway city center. The route passes through the city center, starting from Claddagh, crossing Wolfe Tone Bridge, along Merchants Road and Docks, returning via Grattan Road and Promenade, finishing quickly at South Park, near Nimmos Pier. This route goes past most of the city's most famous landmarks. The race is AAI certified.

name: Resolution Run 2026
description: Resolution Run 2027 invites you to start the new year energetically and actively. It is a great opportunity to fulfill New Year's resolutions by running together with a crowd of enthusiastic runners. The event guarantees a good mood, smiles, and a fun start to the year in Kaunas.
course_highlights: Distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Warm-up for all distance participants
Running through the streets of Kaunas
additional: Participant kits distribution and awards are scheduled in the event program. There will be an official opening and warm-up for all distance participants during the event. The event takes place in Kaunas, organized by VšĮ Kauno maratono klubas. Distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km; the event will be held in Kaunas; the organizer offers a festive start and community spirit.

name: LBT Kėdainiai
location: Kėdainių miesto centrinis stadionas (J. Basanavičiaus g. 1.)
description: Kėdainių sporto centras organizes the LBT 1 – New Year Run "KĖDAINIAI 2025", which will take place on January 5th at 12:00 PM at the central stadium of Kėdainiai (J. Basanavičiaus g. 1). The race distances include a 400 m children’s run, as well as 4 km and 8.5 km routes.
course_highlights: Event date and time: January 5th at 12:00 PM
Location: Kėdainiai central stadium, J. Basanavičiaus g. 1
Race distances: 400 m children’s run, 4 km, and 8.5 km routes

name: Gyvybės ir Mirties bėgimas
description: In Vilnius, the 31st annual run in honor of the victims of the January 13 events, called "The Road of Life and Death," took place on Saturday, with about 6,000 participants. The "Road of Life and Death" run has been held every year since 1992, except in 2021 due to COVID-19 pandemic restrictions. The record number of participants was reached three years ago, when more than 8,000 runners took part in the event.

XXVI Pagarbos bėgimas „Gyvybės ir Mirties keliu“ logotipas.

name: Aplink Želvos ežerą
description: The 'Run Around Lake Želva' will take place on January 11, 2025, in Suginčiai (Molėtai district), dedicated to the memory of Lithuania's Freedom Fighters Day. The event is organized to promote running in Lithuania, enhance athletic excellence, and advocate for a healthy and active lifestyle. It is recommended to arrive around 10:00 AM, with the race starting at 11:00 AM.

name: Trail Kalvė
description: Trail Kalvė is a Backyard ultra type run designed to make it easier for runners to complete a 100-mile distance. If you haven't experienced a DNF (Did Not Finish) in your life yet, this is your chance to earn it honorably. There will be only one winner.
course_highlights: Backyard ultra style race
Designed for 100-mile completion
Opportunity to experience a DNF
Single winner will be crowned

name: XXV bėgimas Laisvės gynėjų dienai paminėti
description: The 25th Run in commemoration of the Day of the Defenders of Freedom in Klaipėda is a traditional running event dedicated to honoring those who died and fought for Lithuania's freedom. The event brings together the city community and visitors, taking place on January 18 in Klaipėda. Participants can choose from two distances - an 8 km main route and a 3 km short route, designed for schoolchildren, seniors, and anyone for whom the long route is too challenging. The start is in the evening, and the routes pass through beautiful city locations, including a bicycle path and the Summer Stage.
course_highlights: The 8 km route runs along the bicycle path through Klaipėda Summer Stage, Liepų and H. Manto streets
Finish line at Klaipėda City Municipality (Liepų g. 11)
The 3 km route starts near Klaipėda Summer Stage, intended for schoolchildren and seniors
additional: Numbers with an outdoor RFID chip. It is recommended to pick up numbers in advance to avoid queues on the event day. Number pickup for 8 km runners is at the bus from the Town Hall, for 3 km runners - near the Summer Stage. Buses depart to the start locations at 19:00. Individual warm-up from 19:45 to 19:55. Route closing at 21:20. Medals are awarded to the first 900 finishers. The event is organized with buses and community participation, starting in Klaipėda at the Giruliai Radio and TV Tower.

name: VI Utenos sporto arenos maratonas
description: Utena Arena Marathon is a unique indoor marathon held in Utena city. Participants run 182.5 laps of 231.3 meters each, providing an exceptional opportunity to experience a marathon in a controlled environment. The event attracts both experienced runners and amateurs seeking to test their endurance and speed. It is a traditional event held annually that promotes sportsmanship and community spirit.
course_highlights: Indoor venue - running takes place inside the arena
182.5 laps of 231.3 meters each
Controlled environment unaffected by weather conditions
additional: Registration takes place only on the day of the event at the start location; pre-registration is not available. The event will be held in Utena, Lithuania; the date of the event is February 7, 2027; the event description emphasizes community spirit and various running activities.

name: 15-asis bėgimas „Žiema Jonavoje“
description: The 15th Winter Run in Jonava invites runners to participate in the traditional winter event around Jonava. The event takes place on bike paths around the Jonava ponds, offering an opportunity to enjoy winter nature and active leisure. It is a great chance for both experienced and beginner runners to test their endurance and enjoy a community atmosphere. The event is held in February when winter is still fully present in nature.
course_highlights: Running around the Jonava ponds
The route runs along bike paths
Winter nature and clean air environment
additional: The event attracts participants from various cities in Lithuania, and participation is open to all age groups. In 2024, the number of participants was 88, and the scenic routes are suitable for runners of different levels.

description: Trail Hill S4E4 Prienai is a winter off-road running race held at Giraitiškės Recreation Area in Prienai. This stage traditionally took place in autumn, but this season participants are invited to test the course in winter. The race offers various distances suitable for runners of different ages and experience levels, from children to adults. The event is part of the Trail Hill Cup, which includes courses of varying difficulty with different elevation gains.
course_highlights: Course lengths from 5 km to 23 km with varying elevation gain
Winter season provides a unique opportunity to run on snow-covered forest trails
Start at Giraitiškės Recreation Area, Prienai
additional: The race does not award medals, but first-time registrants for the season receive a Trail Hill running band. Since the event takes place in winter, the trails are snow-covered and require special preparation. Registration is only available for team participants; individual categories are recommended to use simple tickets. Participants are encouraged to register in teams; the event is held at Giraitiškės Recreation Area, with the course in winter conditions.

name: Bėgimas varžybos „Bėgame už Laisvę“ 2026
description: The running race "Running for Freedom" is a special running event in Mažeikiai, dedicated to commemorating February 16th - the Day of Restoration of Lithuania's Independence. The event promotes an active lifestyle, community, and celebration of freedom. Participants are invited to join this traditional celebration and run together for freedom.
course_highlights: 10 km run on the road
Event takes place in Mažeikiai
Dedicated to February 16th commemoration
additional: It is recommended for all runners to gather at the start line at 11:35 AM. The event features participants of various age groups, registration is held at M. Račkauskas Gymnasium, and participants are awarded medals.

name: Respublikinis bėgimas „Pabaiskas - Ukmergė“, skirtas Lietuvos Valstybės atkūrimo dienai
location: Ukmergė, Ukmergė district municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: The national run "Pabaiskas - Ukmergė" is held in Ukmergė to celebrate Lithuania's Independence Day. It is a traditional race attended by running enthusiasts from all over Lithuania, aimed at promoting patriotism, active leisure, and running sport. The competition includes an 11.6 km distance starting in Pabaiskas and a 3 km distance for students at the Ukmergė hippodrome. After the finish, participants are awarded medals, and the event concludes with an award ceremony for the winners and tea refreshments.
course_highlights: 11.6 km distance starting in Pabaiskas
3 km distance for students at Ukmergė hippodrome
Finish at Ukmergė Sports Center stadium
additional: Number distribution takes place at the Ukmergė Sports Center stadium gym from 9:30 to 11:00. Buses depart to Pabaiskas at 11:15. After the finish, all participants receive commemorative medals and are awarded the youngest and oldest participants. Race winners are awarded cups and medals. All participants are responsible for their health condition, either themselves or their accompanying persons. During the event, concerts, exhibitions, and other cultural activities are held in Ukmergė, with approximately 120 runners participating.

name: Klajoklio maratonas #25: Kūjagalviai
price_range: dalyvių startinis mokestis negrąžinamas, registracijos perleidimas 5€
description: The Klajoklis Marathon is a traditional running event in Lithuania, taking place in various locations since 2020. This event brings together running enthusiasts for unique marathons where participants can experience different natural and urban environments. Each year, the marathon is held in different parts of Lithuania, and the 25th marathon in 2027 will be held in Kūjagalviai. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and amateurs seeking to test their endurance and enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: The marathon takes place in various locations across Lithuania, providing a unique experience each year
The Kūjagalviai marathon route features natural beauty and challenges for runners
The event attracts both professional and amateur runners from all over Lithuania
additional: running event Kūjagalviai, awards, post-race entertainment

name: XXXVII tradicinis bėgimas „Obeliskas A. Kulviečiui – Jonava“
location: Jonava, Jonava District Municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: The traditional run "Obelisk A. Kulviečiui - Jonava" is a stage of the Lithuanian Running Cup held in Jonava. This event invites running enthusiasts and professionals to participate in various distances, promoting a healthy lifestyle and sporting spirit. The run is part of the Lithuanian Running Cup, which includes several stages across the country. The event is organized by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė to popularize running and encourage continuous participation in competitions.
course_highlights: More than 1100 participants from Lithuania and abroad
Traditional distances: 2 km and 15 km
March 11 commemorative events and concerts
additional: Registrations are managed by and the participant fee is collected by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The paid start fee is non-refundable unless the event is canceled. Participants can change the distance or transfer their registration to another participant no later than the closing of early registration, with a fee of 10 euros. The first stage of the run begins at 08:00. The event is a stage of the Lithuanian Running Cup, offering awards and a photo gallery. All age groups are welcome to participate.

description: The 'Pamario Trophy' run is a traditional event in Šilutė, aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle and popularizing running. The event is organized by the Šilutė District Municipality together with local sports organizations. Participants are invited to run various distances, including a 400 m children's track located in the city center near the municipality. The event features a friendly atmosphere and seeks to bring together both local residents and visitors.
course_highlights: Start near Šilutė District Municipality
Children's track - 400 m in the city center
Participants run with electronic timing measurement
additional: Number distribution takes place on the day of the race near the Šilutė Cultural Center and on March 10 at the Šilutė Leisure and Sports House reception. Children’s race participants can run accompanied by one parent or guardian. Each participant must attach a number with an electronic timing microchip to the front of their shirt. The event takes place in Šilutė, often associated with Lithuania's Independence Day, with about 500 participants, offering various distances and prizes.

name: 2026 metų Kovo 11-osios bėgimas, skirtas Lietuvos Nepriklausomybės atkūrimo dienai paminėti

description: The 2026 March 11 Run is dedicated to celebrating Lithuania's Independence Restoration Day and aims to encourage the public to engage in sports as well as to identify the most capable runners across various age groups. The event takes place near the Gargždai Culture Center, and participants can choose different distances based on age and physical fitness. The run is open to all interested, with participants starting in groups from 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM. It is a traditional event that not only promotes physical activity but also unites the community in celebration of an important date.
course_highlights: Start and finish near Gargždai Culture Center
Different distances from 1.3 km to 14.3 km according to age groups
The route consists of laps, run according to age group
additional: Participant number pickup takes place on the race day from 8:45 AM to 9:30 AM. Participants start in two groups: I-III groups at 10:00 AM, IV-V groups at 10:30 AM. Registration is only available online until March 10 at 8:00 PM. During the run, it is prohibited to accompany participants with bicycles or other means; directional signs will be on the route. The routes vary, registration is online, awards will be given, and traffic will be regulated during the event.

name: Nuotykių lenktynės „Aplink Rėkyvos ežerą“
description: Adventure race "Around Lake Rėkyva" is a stage of the Lithuanian Running Cup held in Šiauliai near Lake Rėkyva. It is approximately 14.5 km long run designed for both amateur and professional runners to promote running and encourage a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place in spring and is part of the Lithuanian Running Cup series, which includes various runs across Lithuania. Participants are invited to test their strength and enjoy the natural scenery around the lake.
course_highlights: Approximately 14.5 km long distance around Lake Rėkyva
Held in Šiauliai, surrounded by nature
This is a stage of the Lithuanian Running Cup, suitable for both amateurs and professionals
additional: The paid start fee is non-refundable unless the event is canceled. Participants can change the distance or transfer their registration to another participant before the pre-registration deadline, paying a 10 euro change fee. Registration and start fee administration are handled by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The event took place on 2026-03-15, with a planned date of 2027-03-21; the route is not marked, participants choose their own route, with orientation and tactics being important.

name: Riešės krosas
location: Riešės hipodrome, Vilniaus r., Vilnius, Lithuania
description: Riešės Cross is a traditional cross-country running event held at the Riešės Hippodrome in Vilnius district. The competition aims to popularize cross-country running and athletics, promote a healthy lifestyle, and increase physical activity. The track surface is 100% natural, consisting of the hippodrome loop, outdoor trails, forest paths, and grassy terrain, making the run varied and hilly. Participants are divided into age groups, and upon finishing, everyone receives commemorative souvenirs, with prizes for the winners of each age group.
course_highlights: 100% natural surface: hippodrome loop, outdoor trails, forest paths, grassy terrain
Hilly course with possible mud or snow depending on weather conditions
Different lap counts based on age groups and distances
additional: Number distribution takes place on the day of the event from 09:30 to 10:50 near the start-finish zone. The event schedule may change depending on the number of participants, with updates communicated when collecting bibs. Participants are responsible for their own health, and minors are the responsibility of parents or guardians. All finishers receive commemorative souvenirs, and winners and prize-winners in each age group are awarded medals, monetary, and material prizes. The event will be held on 2027-03-27 at the Riešės Hippodrome, Vilnius district, and aims to promote an active lifestyle and community spirit.

name: ULTRA 55 !!!
location: Bėgimo namai Kūjagalviai, Kauno rajonas, Lithuania
description: ULTRA 55!!! is a birthday ultra run dedicated to celebrating the 55th birthday of long-time running enthusiast Vidas Totilas. The event takes place at the Running House in Kūjagalviai, Kaunas district, and aims to promote long-distance running in Lithuania and expand the community of long-distance runners. The course consists of forest and outdoor trails with sandy sections, and the start and finish are at the same point. Everyone can participate regardless of age, gender, or nationality, and participation is free of charge.
course_highlights: Forest and outdoor trails
Sandy sections on the course
Start and finish at the Running House in Kūjagalviai
additional: Registration is available online and on the race day from 9:30 to 10:55 AM. Participation is free. All finishers receive commemorative medals, awards in absolute and age group categories. After the finish, participants can enjoy hot soup, snacks, drinks, as well as entertainment - sauna and hot tub. The event is part of the Running House race series, held annually and attracting experienced ultramarathon runners.

name: Bėgimas „Runway Run 2026“
location: Lietuvos oro pajėgų bazė, Šiauliai, Lithuania
description: Runway Run 2026 is a 3 km run held at the Lithuanian Air Force Base in Šiauliai. This event offers a unique opportunity to run on a takeoff and landing strip, which is an unusual and interesting running location. The event is aimed at school students, college students, the community, and the public, promoting an active lifestyle and sports activities. Participants can enjoy a special atmosphere and test their strength on this unique course.
course_highlights: 3 km run on a takeoff and landing strip
Location: Lithuanian Air Force Base, Šiauliai
Unique running course on an airport territory
additional: The event is intended for school students, college students, the college community, and the public. Registration is ongoing, but prices and registration deadlines were not specified. Free parking may be available for students. The event is organized by Šiauliai State College. The event date is April 3, 2027, the race distance is 3 km, and the location is Šiauliai, Lithuanian Air Force Base. Registration details are not provided.

name: Trailo kalvės S4E5. Bražuolė. Finalas
description: Trailo Kalvė S4E5 Bražuolė Final is the final stage of the traditional Lithuanian trail running cup season, held in the Bražuolė area. The event offers various distances suitable for participants of different ages and experience levels, from youth to adults. The routes feature wooded surroundings with varying lengths and difficulty levels, allowing participants to experience the beauty and challenges of nature. Participants start at the Bražuolė campsite, and the event is friendly and open to all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Wooded routes in the Bražuolė area
Different distances from 4.8 km to 24.8 km
Routes with various elevation gains and natural scenery
additional: Start at Bražuolė campsite. The routes include elevation gains ranging from up to 150 m to over 500 m, depending on the distance. The event features categories for youth and adults. The event merchandise is inspired by forest animals, and part of the proceeds are donated to support care organizations. Different distances are offered at the event, registration is conducted online, and the location is Bražuolė campsite, Pugainiai.

name: Tradicinės bėgimo varžybos „Senvagė-2026“
location: Senvagė and Kultūros ir poilsio parkas, Panevėžys, Lithuania
description: The traditional running race "Senvagė-2026" is part of the Lithuanian Running Cup stage, taking place in Panevėžys, at Senvagė and the Culture and Recreation Park. This event brings together running enthusiasts from various cities to promote sports activity, a healthy lifestyle, and the appreciation of the natural and cultural beauty of Lithuanian regions. The race is part of the long-standing Lithuanian Running Cup tradition, which has been uniting runners and amateurs across the country since 2009. The event is held in spring, providing participants with the opportunity to enjoy nature and active recreation.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Senvagė and the Culture and Recreation Park in Panevėžys
A traditional Lithuanian Running Cup stage with runners from different cities
Encourages discovering the natural and architectural beauty of Lithuanian regions
additional: Registration is managed by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The paid start fee is non-refundable unless the event is canceled. Participants can change the distance or transfer their registration to others no later than the closing of pre-registration, with the difference in price between the more expensive and cheaper distances not refunded. The participant change fee is 10 euros. The event will be held at Kranto g. 24, Panevėžys, with online registration available.

name: Bėgimas, skirtas Pasaulinei sveikatos dienai paminėti
organizer: Lietuvos sporto draugija „Žalgiris“ ir Kėdainių sporto centras
description: Kėdainių sporto centras invites everyone to participate in a run dedicated to celebrating World Health Day. The event is community-oriented and active, aimed at promoting healthy lifestyles, physical activity, and strengthening the community's physical and mental health. It is a great opportunity for families, children, youth, and older adults to gather and spend time actively in Kėdainiai. The event is part of the National Physical Activity Program, designed to organize mass physical activity events.
course_highlights: Physical activity activities
Health testing
Community engagement
additional: The event is intended for all age groups - families, children, youth, and older residents. Organized by the Lithuanian Sports Society "Žalgiris" and Kėdainiai Sports Center. The event is part of the National Physical Activity Program, encouraging mass physical activity. It includes various physical activities, testing, sports competitions, and lectures, taking place in Kėdainiai, with the main venue being the central city stadium.

name: Bėgimas „Tropem Wilczym 2026“
organizer: Lenkijos Respublikos ambasada Vilniuje, Lietuvos lenkų jaunimas, asociacija „Sporto renginiai“
description: The international run "Tropem Wilczym 2026" will take place in Vilnius, Vingis Park, and is dedicated to honoring anti-fascist, anti-communist, and anti-Soviet underground fighters. The event promotes running and athletics in Lithuania, encourages a healthy lifestyle, and aims to bring together runners of all ages. Participants can choose from several distances, and the event is organized with great attention to safety and professionalism. It is a great opportunity for both professionals and amateurs to participate in a meaningful sports event.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Vingis Park near the stage
Distances: symbolic run of 1963 meters, 5.2 km, 10.5 km, and half marathon
Route closure and traffic restrictions to ensure safety

It is possible to change the distance for a fee of 2 EUR. Participants must have an ID to receive their bib number. The event combines sport and history, offering several distances including the symbolic 1963-meter route, and emphasizes community importance. Participants are divided into age groups, and the use of vehicles or personal escorts is prohibited.

The event offers courses ranging from beginner-friendly 15+ km to the challenging 108 km trail around Vilnius. Participants will enjoy diverse terrain, including forest trails, mountain paths, and scenic viewpoints that provide unforgettable Lithuanian landscape views. It is a great opportunity to test your endurance and explore the city's nature and culture through running.

Varied terrain: forest trails, mountain paths
Scenic viewpoints with Lithuanian landscape views

Organizer: VšĮ, address: Balžio g. 21C-5, Vilnius, phone: +370 610 24484. The event offers routes that include forest trails, mountain paths, and scenic viewpoints; participants can choose from various distances and age groups, including ultramarathon and children's runs.

course_highlights: Traditional route Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė
Part of the spring sports festival
Held annually since at least 2018

name: Kauno Akropolio maratonas 2026
description: Kaunas Akropolis Marathon is an annual international running event in Kaunas attracting thousands of participants. The event is open to everyone regardless of age or physical fitness and aims to promote social and physical activity as well as healthy lifestyle traditions in Lithuania. The marathon and half marathon courses are certified by the International Association of Athletics Federations (WA) and the Association of International Marathons and Distance Races (AIMS). It is a sports celebration for both professionals and amateurs, taking place in a safe environment that meets high standards.
course_highlights: Marathon and half marathon courses are certified by WA and AIMS
Course measured according to international standards
Event certified with a 5-star quality mark
additional: The event is certified with a 5-star quality mark, ensuring the highest level of safety and services. The marathon courses meet international standards. The event is designed for both professionals and amateurs, taking place in Kaunas city. Organized by VšĮ "Kauno maratono klubas". During the event, remote running options, group registrations, and various distances are offered, with certified courses.

name: Palangos pusės maratono bėgimas „PRALENK ŽIRGĄ“
description: The Palanga Half Marathon Run "PRALENK ŽIRGĄ" is a high-quality half marathon event dedicated to the Jurginės festival. The event aims to establish Palanga as a European sports city, promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and visitors. The run takes place in the resorts of Palanga and Šventoji, increasing the offering of mass sports events and involving the local community in sports activities.
course_highlights: Start in Šventoji and finish in Palanga
The route is marked and adapted for runners
Encourages a healthy lifestyle and promotes sports
additional: Traffic restrictions and public relations campaigns are planned to ensure the smooth conduct of the event.

name: SwampMan Backyard ultra 6 by Trailo Kalvė
description: SwampMan Backyard Ultra 6 by Trailo Kalvė is a unique endurance race in Alytus, near Dailidės Lake. This event invites runners to test their limits by running a Backyard Ultra format course, which makes it easier to complete a 100-mile distance. There will be only one winner of the race, and the challenge is significant – it seems easy only up to a certain point. It is a great opportunity to experience the true spirit of endurance running and to earn a respectable DNF status.
course_highlights: Trail running around Dailidės Lake
Endurance format Backyard Ultra designed for completing 100 miles
Race location in Alytus, on the slopes of Vidzgiris
additional: Race regulations are available in PDF format. The event takes place in Alytus, near Dailidės Lake. The number of participants exceeds 120. The race follows the Backyard Ultra format, where the winner is the last remaining runner. The event location is in Alytus, near Dailidės Lake, with a course length of about 6.7 km featuring wooded and paved sections, with the possibility to bring your own tent, parking for cars and campers outside the start zone, food and drinks during the event.

name: 63-asis tradicinis bėgimas „Anykščiai - Puntuko akmuo - Anykščiai“
description: The 63rd traditional run "Anykščiai - Puntuko akmuo - Anykščiai" invites participants to actively spend time on May 7th in the stunning landscape of Anykščiai. The running routes are designed to suit participants of all ages and fitness levels, from children's recreational runs to 11 km endurance races. The event is the oldest in Lithuania and is renowned for its tradition and friendly atmosphere, attracting sports enthusiasts from across the country. Participants will receive commemorative medals, and the fastest in the 11 km distance will be awarded cash prizes.
course_highlights: Scenic route through the landscape of Anykščiai, along the forest of Anykščiai celebrated by Antanas Baranauskas
Different distances: from 300 m for children to 11 km for endurance runners
Start near the Angel Museum in Anykščiai
additional: Starts are organized by age groups: 10:30 AM - children's recreational run "Puntukėlis"; 11:30 AM - 3 km distance; 11:50 AM - opening of the event; 12:00 PM - 6 km and 11 km distances. Registration is only open until April 28th at 12:00 PM; same-day registration will not be available. Participants who reach the finish line will receive commemorative medals. The fastest in the 11 km distance will be awarded cash prizes. Pre-registration is recommended, with options to recharge after the race at the pool and sauna complex, prizes and discounts, and activities for various age groups.

name: Klaipėdos EKOMaratonas
description: Klaipėda Eco-Marathon is a traditional running event held along the Giruliai forest trails in Klaipėda. The event is open to both amateurs and professionals, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. The course length varies from 2 km for schoolchildren to 42.2 km for eco-marathon participants, who run 10 laps of 4.2 km each. The event is organized by the Klaipėda City Runners Club "Marathon" and supported by the Klaipėda City Municipality.
course_highlights: Eco-marathon course - 10 laps of 4.2 km through Giruliai forest trails
Schoolchildren's course - 2 km (1 km forward, 1 km back)
Start in Giruliai forest, at the beginning of the bike path near the Summer Stage
additional: On race day, the timing system operates until 15:00. Participants' start fees are paid on-site when collecting their bibs. The first 300 participants receive commemorative medals, and all participants receive certificates. Participants must present an ID to collect their bib. Participants agree that the event organizers may use photos and video footage taken during the event for marketing purposes. Distances are 4.2 km and 42.2 km; schoolchildren's distance is 2 km. The start is in Giruliai forest. Online registration is open until April 30.

name: Vilniaus pavasario maratonas
description: Vilnius Spring Marathon invites runners of all levels to test their strength in the spring rhythm at Vingis Park in Vilnius. The event offers various distances from 600 meters for children to the classic marathon of 42.195 km, as well as a half marathon and shorter runs. It is a great opportunity to start the running season surrounded by nature, moving through the city and parks, enjoying the spring revival. The event is organized with great attention to the experience of all participants and encourages an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Vingis Park stage
Running through Vilnius city parks and streets
Distances from 600 m for children to 42.195 km for the marathon
additional: The event takes place on 2026-05-02, starting at 10:00 AM at the Vingis Park stage. Distances: 42.195 km, 21.098 km, 10.6 km, 5.3 km, and 600 m for children. Regulations are published at https://www.myrace.lt/maratonadienis/nuostatai/. Registration is available at https://www.myrace.lt/maratonadienis. The event offers various distances, including children and youth runs, as well as the option to participate with insurance. Registration is conducted through myrace.lt.

name: RASA Druskininkų maratonas
organizer: Asociacija Sporto renginiai ir Druskininkų sporto centras
description: The Druskininkai Race Marathon is an international running event held in Druskininkai near Lake Vijūnėlė. The event promotes running as a healthy lifestyle and aims to popularize athletics in Lithuania and increase the activity of Druskininkai residents. Participants of all ages can take part, but only those aged 18 and over can start in the marathon and half-marathon categories. Participants compete in various distances from 500 meters to a marathon, and all are awarded special event medals.
course_highlights: 500 m, 5 km, 10.5 km, half-marathon and marathon distances
Starts from 10:00 AM, time limits of 5 hours for marathon and half-marathon distances
The race takes place near Lake Vijūnėlė in Druskininkai
additional: Starts are organized in waves: 10:00 - 500 m (timing not recorded), 10:17 - 5 km (time limit 43 min), 11:00 - 10.5 km, half-marathon and marathon (time limit 5 hours). Participants compete only for themselves. Only individuals aged 18 and over can participate in the marathon and half-marathon categories. All participants receive special event medals, and winners in the 1st to 3rd places are awarded winners' cups. Distances: 500 m, 5 km, 10.5 km, half-marathon, marathon; online registration; awards for top finishers.

name: Red Bull Wings for Life World run
description: Red Bull Wings for Life World Run is a unique run held simultaneously worldwide, including Vingio Park in Vilnius. Participants run as far as they can until they are caught by the "Catch Car." This event is dedicated to supporting spinal cord injury research, with 100% of participant fees allocated to scientific studies. Join thousands of runners around the world and run for those who cannot.
course_highlights: Run takes place in Vingio Park, Vilnius
Start simultaneously with runners worldwide
Unique "Catch Car" format that ends the run
additional: Start time is 11:00 UTC. Participants run as far as they can until they are caught by the "Catch Car." 100% of participant fees are allocated to spinal cord injury research. The event occurs simultaneously worldwide, including Vilnius. The event is held in Vingio Park, with participants choosing to run or walk, and there is no traditional finish line; funds are raised for spinal injury research.

name: A.Vietrino taurės bėgimo varžybos
organizer: Lietuvos lengvosios atletikos federacija, Kauno bėgimo mėgėjų klubas, Lietuvos sporto universitetas
description: The A. Vietrinas Cup running race is held in memory of Lithuania's marathon pioneer Alfonso Vietrinas. The event takes place in Kaunas Ąžuolynas Park, with the start and finish near the S. Darius and S. Girėnas monument. Participants can choose between 2.5 km or 10 km distances, and the course is certified and consists of a 2.5 km loop. The event promotes running in Lithuania and invites all interested to participate with a doctor's permission.
course_highlights: Course runs through Ąžuolynas Park
One lap length - 2.5 km, certified course
Start and finish near the S. Darius and S. Girėnas monument
additional: The 2.5 km distance starts at 11:30 AM, the 10 km distance starts at 12:00 PM. Participants must wear a bib on the front of their shirts. Age group winners and runners-up will be awarded with trophies, as well as the youngest and oldest participants. The use of transport and personal escort during the race is prohibited. The aim of the event is to promote physical activity and the running community in Lithuania.

name: Tarptautinės bėgimo varžybos „Kresowe Trail“
location: Nemenčinės apylinkės, Nemenčinė, Vilniaus rajonas, Lithuania
organizer: Vilniaus rajono savivaldybė, Vilniaus rajono sporto centras, Vilniaus rajono sporto mokykla, fondas Maratony Kresowe
description: The international running event "Kresowe Trail" in Nemenčinė offers a unique opportunity to run through the surroundings of the Vilnius district sports center. The event takes place on June 2, and the routes vary in length - from the shorter 6 km Szpurt run to the longer 18.6 km Wertep route. The event is suitable for both professional runners and amateurs, with electronic timing and a start number valid for the entire season. Participants can enjoy routes marked with green and red arrows, and after the run, awards and warm meals are provided.
course_highlights: Szpurt 6 km run marked with green arrows on a yellow background
Wertep 18.6 km run marked with red arrows
Two refreshment points on the Wertep route

The race office operates on June 1 from 15:00 to 18:00 at the Vilnius district sports center. The time limit on the routes is 2 hours and 15 minutes. Electronic timing and a free start number with a time counter, valid for the entire season, are provided. After the run, warm meals are offered to participants. Start sectors are separated by distances: Szpurt 6 km and Wertep 19 km. The event features refreshment points, electronic timing, free start numbers, medical coverage, and awards.

The race takes place near the Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge, offering three distances: about 463 meters, 2.5 km, and 10 km. Participants can enjoy a symbolic route and a friendly atmosphere, with the event concluding with awards and a communal finish around 21:30.
course_highlights: Symbolic approximately 463 m route near Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge
2.5 km loop, which 10 km runners complete four times
Race held in the city environment with a convenient start and finish

Participants must be healthy or have a doctor's note to participate. The health and behavior of minors are monitored by accompanying persons. Race location is near the Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge, registration and bib collection are at the bridge, with categories for different age groups, and COVID-19 safety requirements.

name: HANNER bėgimas į dangoraižį „Europa“
location: Europa Tower, Vilnius, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: The HANNER Run up the Europa Tower is a traditional annual challenge inviting running enthusiasts and extreme sports fans to ascend 31 floors of the Europa business center, the tallest in the Baltic States. The event brings together both professionals and amateurs aiming to improve their endurance and athletic results. The course must be completed within 10 minutes, with winners typically finishing in 3-4 minutes. The fastest runners are awarded cash prizes and sponsor gifts.
course_highlights: 31 floors of the business center to the terrace
Course completion time up to 10 minutes
Records reach 2 minutes 55.6 seconds for men and 3 minutes 28.6 seconds for women
additional: All participants start every half minute to avoid congestion. The fastest runners are awarded cash prizes and sponsor gifts. The event is organized by the real estate development company 'Hanner' and the 'Lithuanian Running Cup' team. The event is scheduled to take place on May 22, 2027, inviting participants from all over Lithuania and abroad. Participants are encouraged to reach the top of the Europa Tower, and the event is known as one of the most exciting and challenging running events in Vilnius.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 1 etapas
description: Jonavos bėgimo taurė is a traditional running competition held in Jonavos district, aimed at promoting sports and physical activity. Participants compete in overall standings as well as in age groups, with routes passing through various areas of Jonavos district, providing an interesting and diverse running experience. Registration is conducted online, and bib numbers are collected on the day of the event at the start location.

Start and finish at various locations, including Jonavos city central stadium and municipality buildings
Events take place in the evening, starting at 19:30, with bib number collection from 18:30 to 19:20
additional: Bib numbers are collected on the day of the event from 18:30 to 19:20 at the start location. Registration for each stage is conducted separately. Participation in the event is free of charge. The event is open to all participants, offering online registration and different routes, taking place over five stages from May to September.

name: Kėdainių bėgimas „Babėnų pavasaris 2026“
location: Babėnų miško poilsio aikštelė, Kėdainiai, Lithuania

The event aims to promote physical activity among participants of all ages and provide an opportunity to compete and showcase running abilities. The routes run through forest trails and paths, and every finisher will receive a commemorative medal. The race is organized in cooperation with Kėdainiai Sports Center and the Lithuanian Running Enthusiasts Association.

5 km and 10 km distances
The event takes place at Babėnų forest recreation area, at the end of Aušros and Budrio streets

Winners and prize recipients are awarded in each age group, as well as the top 3 fastest participants in the 5 km and 10 km distances. All finishers will receive a commemorative medal. The event is planned for May 26, 2027, but no details about the routes or participant fee have been provided.

name: Tradicinis bėgimas „Laisvės taku 2026“
description: The traditional run "Freedom Trail 2026" will take place on May 22, 2026, in the town of Šimkaičiai, Jurbarkas district, to commemorate the 117th anniversary of General Jonas Žemaitis's birth. It is an 11 km cross-country race starting from the General Jonas Žemaitis headquarters. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, and honors the memory of Lithuania's freedom fighter. Participants are invited to register in advance and take part in a community sports event.
course_highlights: 11 km cross-country race in the Šimkaičiai area
Start from the General Jonas Žemaitis headquarters
Bus transportation to the start point from Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis primary school
additional: Participant registration is from 9:00 to 9:30 AM. Number pickup is on May 23, 2025, from 9:00 to 9:30 AM. Registration location - Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis primary school. Departure by bus to the start at 09:45 from the school. Awards are scheduled for 13:00. Participants must have a doctor’s note or have undergone a health check. Results will be publicly announced. Photos and video footage will be taken during the event for marketing purposes. The event will be held at Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis primary school, with age categories for participants and online registration options.

name: If Vilniaus Pusmaratonis 2026
description: The "If" Vilnius Half Marathon is the biggest spring running celebration in Vilnius, taking place in the city’s Old Town. The event invites runners of all ages - from children to half marathon participants. The run promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and community spirit, and participants can feel safe as all runners are insured against accidents. The event features various distances and a friendly atmosphere, creating long-lasting connections among participants.
course_highlights: Start at Cathedral Square in Vilnius Old Town
Half marathon distance - 21.098 km
Children's and youth runs for various age groups
additional: Participants who register by April 4th receive personalized bib numbers. Event shirts can be purchased for an additional fee. The event includes children's runs from age 2, a 4.2 km youth run, and 5 km and 10 km distances without age restrictions. Participants receive start packages with timing chips. The program includes warm-up sessions and awards for each distance. The event features participants of various age groups, multiple start times, and additional activities in Vilnius city and the Old Town.

course_highlights: 1000-meter distance on the stadium athletics track
Professionally prepared track at the stadium
Race held at Trakai Stadium, Birutės g. 44

The race is an official 1000 m event suitable for both young athletes and amateurs. The event is included in the endurance sports calendar, offering participants the chance to compete and enjoy the sporting atmosphere in Trakai.

Prizes awarded from Pavel Fedorenko and the Kupiškis District Culture and Sports Center
Location Kupiškis, Lithuania
additional: The event will take place on May 29, 2027. Registration is available online and via social media.

name: Bėgam už Marijampolę - 2026
description: Run for Marijampolė is a traditional annual running event held in Marijampolė, bringing together participants of all ages. It is not only a competition but also a regional gathering outdoors, promoting an active lifestyle and community spirit. The event features a renovated running route that allows participants to test their endurance in the beautiful city of Lithuania. Additionally, there is an educational hike called "Walking for Marijampolė" with 8 km and 14 km distances, for which registration is free.
course_highlights: Renovated running route in Marijampolė city
Educational hike with 8 km and 14 km distances
Outdoor event promoting community spirit
additional: The educational hike "Walking for Marijampolė" takes place alongside the run, and registration for the hike is free. The event gathers more than 1000 participants, from children to seniors. Organized by the Marijampolė Athletics Sports Club. The event date is May 30, 2027, with no specific number of participants or distances specified.

name: „Vilnius 5 in 5“ (1 diena)
organizer: VšĮ „Maratomanija“ ir VšĮ “100 marathon club Lithuania”
description: „Vilnius 5 in 5“ is a unique five-day running challenge in Vilnius, where participants can complete five marathons, half-marathons, 12.6 km or 4.2 km distances consecutively. The event encourages endurance, determination, and daily return to the track, offering a true stage running adventure. It is the first event of its kind in Lithuania, inspired by global traditions, held at the Vingis Park stage. Participants can choose their distance and start time, and the event is organized by VšĮ „Maratomanija“ and VšĮ „100 marathon club Lithuania“.
course_highlights: Vingis Park stage in Vilnius
Ability to choose start time at 9:00 or 15:00 on the first three days for 4.2 km and 12.6 km distances
Five starts over five days with different distances: marathon, half-marathon, 12.6 km, and 4.2 km
additional: Race time limits: marathon - 8 hours, half-marathon - 4 hours, 12.6 km - 3 hours, 4.2 km - 1 hour. The route GPX file is available online. Participants must have an ID for bib collection. Minors are under the responsibility of parents, guardians, or coaches. There will be a refreshment point on the route during the event. Participants agree that their photos and video footage may be used for marketing purposes. Multi-day run, routes in Vilnius Vingis Park, various distances, registration and health check are mandatory.

name: Bėgimas „Kutaliai – Kaltinėnai“
description: The running event "Kutaliai - Kaltinėnai" is a traditional cross-country race held to commemorate the 141st anniversary of Lithuanian President Aleksandras Stulginskis and the Day of the Constituent Seimas. The race takes place in a rugged terrain, promoting physical activity and respect for sport. The start is in Kutaliai village, and the finish is at the Aleksandras Stulginskis Gymnasium stadium in Šilalė district. The event is open to athletes from city and district schools as well as all interested participants who meet health requirements.
course_highlights: Start in Kutaliai village, finish at Aleksandras Stulginskis Gymnasium stadium
Rugged terrain, cross-country race
Dedicated to the memory of Lithuanian President Aleksandras Stulginskis
additional: Registration is open until 9:30 AM on the day of the race at Aleksandras Stulginskis Gymnasium in Kaltinėnai. Participants must have a doctor’s note or a medical certificate with a doctor’s signature. All participants receive commemorative medals, and group winners are awarded medals for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd places. The event attracts athletes of all ages; registration and health checks are required. Winners and participants are awarded medals.

name: Samogitia Ultra 2027 - Where Dreams Go to Die
description: Samogitia Ultra is a unique endurance race held in the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai, Lithuania. Participants run a 6.7 km forest trail loop every hour on the hour, continuing until only one runner remains, known as the Last Man Standing. The race challenges runners' endurance, strategy, and grit, with a minimum of 7 loops required to earn a medal. The course features about 70 meters of elevation gain per loop and is set in a beautiful natural reserve.
course_highlights: 6.7 km forest trail loop with ~70 meters elevation gain
Course runs through Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai
100% forest single/double tracks and gravel, day and night same loop
additional: Runners must complete each 6.7 km loop within one hour or be eliminated. Minimum 7 loops (46.9 km) needed for award medal. Runners receive 3, 2, and 1-minute warnings before each loop. Personal tents can be set up from 6 PM the day before the race near the start gate. Toilets are available about 50 meters from base camp. Water and hot water are available at base camp. No showers, but a clean lake is nearby. Walking during the race is allowed and recommended. Personal items can be left in tents but are not the organizer's responsibility. There is a tent camp and aid stations at the event, but there are restrictions on aid along the course.

name: Vilnius 5000 2027
location: Vilnius Vingio parko stadionas, Vilnius, Lithuania
description: Vilnius 5000 is a unique 5000-meter running race held at Vilnius Vingis Park Stadium. Participants have the opportunity to compete alongside the fastest Lithuanian and international runners, enjoy live DJ music, and a festive atmosphere. The event offers various disciplines, including individual 5000 m runs, a 5x1000 m relay, and a 2x400 m father-and-child relay. It is a great chance to improve your personal best and experience unforgettable support and community spirit.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Vilnius Vingis Park Stadium
5000 m run, 5x1000 m mixed relay, and 2x400 m father-and-child relay
Live DJ music and festive atmosphere with a food truck after the finish
additional: Participants are divided into groups based on personal results or estimated completion time. description: The VIII Herb Festival Marathon is a traditional running event held in Vingis Park, Vilnius, dedicated to celebrating the Herb Festival in a healthy, joyful, and meaningful way. The event is open to both professional athletes and beginners, offering various distances from children's runs to a full marathon. Each participant is awarded a metal figurine symbolizing a herb plant, and the course length is a 5.275 km loop, which runners complete according to their chosen distance. The event promotes community spirit and an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course is certified by the Lithuanian Athletics Federation (LAF) and measured by Alfonso Kazlauskas
Loop length - 5.275 km, 8 laps for the marathon
Start is in front of the Vingis Park stage
additional: Participants can choose from 6 distances: marathon (42.2 km), 31.6 km, half marathon (21.1 km), 10.6 km, 5.3 km (one lap), and a 600 m children's run. Each participant is awarded a metal figurine, the design of which changes annually, symbolizing different herb plants. The event celebrates traditions and community spirit, offering various distances and symbolic awards featuring herb plants.

name: XXXV-as tradicinis tarptautinis estafetinis bėgimas „Baltijos Kelias“
description: The 35th traditional international relay race "Baltic Way" will take place from August 21 to 24, 2027. The race symbolically recreates the Baltic Way of 1989, when millions of Lithuanians, Latvians, and Estonians linked hands to seek freedom and independence. The approximately 650-kilometer route runs from Vilnius through Riga to Tallinn, with runners passing the baton in relay style, covering different segments of varying lengths. It is not only a sporting event but also a living history lesson and a celebration of community, bringing together participants and supporters from the three Baltic countries.
course_highlights: Approximately 650 km route from Vilnius through Riga to Tallinn
Relay race across three Baltic states
Symbolic reenactment of the historic Baltic Way live chain
additional: The race lasts four days, during which runners cover up to 200 kilometers daily. The event opening takes place at Vilnius Cathedral Square. Participants pass the baton in relay style, and the race is accompanied by meetings with city and community residents. The event is part of the national physical activity program. It spans four days, with opportunities to welcome and support runners along the way, and is dedicated to commemorating the unity of the Baltic nations.

name: Vilniaus bėgimo klubų taurė
location: Vingio parkas, Vilnius, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilnius, Lithuania
description: Vilnius Running Clubs Cup is a running event held in Vilnius at the Vingis Park athletics stadium. The event is dedicated to running clubs, sports clubs, families, children, youth, adults, seniors, and people with disabilities from Vilnius and other Lithuanian cities. The main race is a team relay 5×1000 m, involving five participants, along with individual 1000 m runs and a 60 m children’s race. The event promotes physical activity, community spirit, and a healthy lifestyle in Vilnius.
course_highlights: The competition takes place at the Vingis Park athletics stadium
Main event - team relay 5×1000 m
Also includes 1000 m individual runs and 60 m children’s race
additional: Race program: 12:00 children’s 60 m race, 13:00 women’s 1000 m race and women’s tricycle race, 13:15 men’s 1000 m race and men’s tricycle race. Relay events for women, mixed, and men are canceled. Organizers reserve the right to adjust start times. The event includes various running competitions, including races for children, adults, and people with disabilities, taking place on August 28, 2027.

name: Naktinis bėgimas 2026
description: Night Run 2026 invites you to feel the rhythm of the night and immerse yourself in the end-of-summer buzz in Kaunas. This is a unique opportunity to relax from everyday life and end the summer with an energetic run accompanied by music, a sea of lights, and the company of inspired runners. The event takes place at the Town Hall Square and Santalka Park, offering stunning views and an unforgettable night adventure. Participants compete in 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances, and the event is suitable for both amateurs and professionals.
course_highlights: Route through Town Hall Square and Santalka Park
Night run with music and a sea of lights
Competitions in 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances
additional: Participants must attach a bib with a timing microchip to the front of their shirts. Registration data and distance changes are possible until 2026-08-23 for a fee of 5 €. Race times may not be recorded if the route is not completed within the set time limit. The use of transport on the route is strictly prohibited. The event will be held in Kaunas, featuring a night run with lights, music, and a lively atmosphere. Registration and more detailed information are available on the official website.

The event brings together people of all ages and social groups to spend time actively and healthily.

Exploring northern Lithuania during the run

organizer: TK Temple Kauno pusmaratonis TS Temple social club
description: The TEMPLE Kaunas Half Marathon '26 is the hottest summer running celebration in Kaunas, taking place on August 29. The event offers four distances: half marathon (21.089 km), 10 km, 5 km, and a 400 m children's run. It is not only a competition but also an experience filled with excitement, adrenaline, and community spirit, inviting both those aiming for personal records and those wanting to enjoy the festive atmosphere of running. This event colors the city with participants' smiles and invites everyone to become part of the history.

Summer running celebration in Kaunas city

name: Alytaus Pusmaratonis – 2026
description: Alytaus half marathon 2026 invites all running enthusiasts to a special summer finish in Alytus. The event starts and ends at Alytus Town Hall Square, and the course takes you through the most beautiful parts of the city - lush parks, cozy streets, and the banks of the Nemunas River. Participants will experience camaraderie, movement, and emotions, and at the finish line, they will be greeted with a festive atmosphere and support. This is a great opportunity to get to know Alytus and take away unforgettable emotions, whether aiming for the best result or simply spending a meaningful day.
course_highlights: Course takes you through lush parks
Cozy city streets
Inspiring Nemunas River banks

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė 5 etapas
description: On the evening of August 21, the Jonavos Sports Center invited running enthusiasts and fans to the fourth stage of the Jonavos Running Cup. This time, participants had to test a prepared 7 km scenic route in Panoteriai village, which was special this August due to the 115th anniversary of Panoteriai School and the 30th anniversary of the consecration of the Holy Cross Discovery Church. Although runners were accompanied by heavy rain, it did not hinder the festive running mood – awards were presented at the very Panoteriai Church.
